commentary: With the deterministic gate flagged WEAK and market breadth subdued at 39, Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil market-timing doctrines call for rigorous defensive capital exposure. Although the Nifty 50 defended key 25,140 support on strong FII institutional net inflows of Rs 4,864 crore, poor broad-market participation warns of elevated failure rates among speculative setups. Jesse Livermore's discipline requires trading only top leaders emerging from sound bases while sitting tight in cash elsewhere. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate keeping pilot position sizing tightly constrained, demanding verified earnings acceleration, respecting precise entry triggers, and strictly cutting losses without hesitation if underlying pivots fail to hold.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis, Darvas Box & Livermore Discipline

AARTIPHARM.technical: Breaking out of a double-bottom base above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA on 1.24x average volume. RSI at 68 confirms constructive momentum without extreme extension, showing classic Stage 2 accumulation characteristics.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Strong CDMO and Xanthine derivative volumes drove Q2 sales to Rs 610 cr (+46% YoY) and net profit to Rs 66 cr (+113% YoY). ROCE stands near 11.4% with manageable leverage and expanding operating margins.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Failure to hold 929.48 breaches the double-bottom base support; exit immediately to preserve capital on any high-volume undercut.

AARTISURF.technical: Powerful SEPA breakout clearing 20-session resistance on massive 10.24x volume surge. Moving averages are sequentially aligned above the 200 SMA, confirming explosive institutional accumulation out of a primary base.
AARTISURF.fundamental: Q2 standalone PAT surged 672% YoY to Rs 12.59 cr on 62.5% revenue growth to Rs 291 cr. Working capital days reduced significantly to 21.5, though historic 3-year ROE remains modest at 5.2%.
AARTISURF.risk: A close below 561.76 invalidates the SEPA breakout pivot; enforce rapid stop discipline to prevent capital erosion.

ABDL.technical: Clearing a Darvas-style box to print a new 52-week high on 1.93x volume. Price action is firmly supported above rising 21 EMA and 50 SMA, signaling sustained buying interest.
ABDL.fundamental: Record quarterly volume exceeding 10M cases drove 15.8% revenue expansion to Rs 1,152 cr, but net profit rose only 9.7% due to supply-chain cost headwinds. Net debt sits elevated at 2.2x EBITDA.
ABDL.risk: Violation of 712.03 breaks the 52-week pivot shelf, triggering immediate risk off pursuant to Minervini loss-cutting rules.

AEROENTER.technical: Consolidating within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot in a tight handle pattern. Moving averages are orderly and stacked in Stage 2 alignment, though volume lacks definitive institutional expansion.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Consolidated Q2 revenue grew 45% YoY with profit up 84%, bolstered by subsidiary operations. However, high other income from stake sales and extended working capital cycles warrant fundamental caution.
AEROENTER.risk: A drop below 146.48 breaches handle support and structural moving averages; execute defined stop discipline immediately.

AGARWALEYE.technical: Constructive double-bottom formation above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Rejection of session lows via a long lower wick shows responsive institutional support defending neckline resistance.
AGARWALEYE.fundamental: Dominant ophthalmology network delivered accelerating earnings with Q2 EPS surging 89% YoY and Q1 up 40%, accompanied by 26% revenue growth. Robust operating margins near 30% underpin high premium valuation multiples.
AGARWALEYE.risk: A break below 531.32 invalidates the double-bottom base pivot and mandates immediate liquidation to control portfolio risk.

ALICON.technical: Double-bottom breakout on 1.45x volume expansion. Price cleanly holds above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with RSI at 68 confirming strong upward trend without reaching overbought territory.
ALICON.fundamental: Record quarterly revenue of Rs 652 cr (+50.4% YoY) propelled by strong auto-component volumes and higher-margin machining mix (68% of sales). Order book additions of Rs 1,000 cr provide solid visibility.
ALICON.risk: Breaching 908.77 violates the double-bottom base pivot; close the position immediately according to SEPA risk parameters.
